overview_description.description:
Voosh develops a decentralized kitchen partner model intended to bring quality and affordable food brands to customers.

The company's platform provides virtual multi-cuisine restaurant chain bringing all small restaurants together to compete with any big brand, it co-brands a small restaurant under its platform and takes over all its marketing expenses, it provides the restaurant with diverse recipes and train their staffs, enabling the restaurant industry to generate enhanced revenue and carry its operations efficiently.
